capabilities: convert a Markdown note to Slack message blocks
open the converted content in the Slack Block Kit builder web page
run the conversion from the command palette
extras: README is minimal (initial release v0.0.1); sending the message happens through Slack's Block Kit builder web page and the user's Slack account, not inside the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note's Markdown into Slack message blocks for posting to Slack.

relations.evidence: It will open the Slack Block Kit builder web page with your content.

summary: Converter that turns a Markdown note into Slack message blocks and opens them in Slack's Block Kit builder for sending.
